    if playerScripts then
        local targetScript = playerScripts:FindFirstChild("Stop trying to leave")
        if targetScript then
            targetScript:Destroy()
            print("bypassed by sigmaboy")

end

    local targetScript = starterScripts:FindFirstChild("Stop trying to leave")
    if targetScript then
        targetScript:Destroy()
        print("lol bypassed anticheat")
    end
end
